source_scope: The opening sentence in Daniel’s captured WikiTree biography links Robert-1156, but its adjacent contributed-tree quotation describes Robert born1612, died1690 in Currituck, wifeAnn Johnson. Those are the compiled identity attributes of Robert-1157. Robert-1156 is the separate record-defined Duddingston man buried17January1647. The copied WikiTree hyperlink is therefore misdirected; the family-tree quotation does not support choosing1156 instead. This identifies the intended modern account, not the historical father, and does not establish the compiled dates, Scottish origin or identity with Virginia Robert Glascocke.
